activity_summary: After the play, before the yard was let out, George told you Philip Howard, Earl of Arundel, had died in the Tower on Sunday. He had been ten years a prisoner, and they never brought him out to die. John had heard it at noon from a man who had it from the parish. You left the fact whole.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked for it undressed, and refused a use for it.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Told the death once, and would not add a character to it.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Said where he had heard it, and kept the parish's words from becoming doctrine.
